Your task is summarize the modifications made in the patch.
Your summary should consist of two parts, modifications in each file and their relationships.

From 9c337073d9d81a145434b22f42dc3128ecd17730 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Taniya Das <tdas@codeaurora.org>
Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2021 22:13:56 +0530
Subject: [PATCH] clk: qcom: gcc-sc7280: Mark gcc_cfg_noc_lpass_clk always
 enabled

The gcc cfg noc lpass clock is required to be always enabled for the
LPASS core and audio drivers to be functional.

Fixes: a3cc092196ef ("clk: qcom: Add Global Clock controller (GCC) driver for SC7280")
Signed-off-by: Taniya Das <tdas@codeaurora.org>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/1640018638-19436-4-git-send-email-tdas@codeaurora.org
Signed-off-by: Stephen Boyd <sboyd@kernel.org>

diff --git a/drivers/clk/qcom/gcc-sc7280.c b/drivers/clk/qcom/gcc-sc7280.c
index 8fb6bd69f240..423627d49719 100644
--- a/drivers/clk/qcom/gcc-sc7280.c
+++ b/drivers/clk/qcom/gcc-sc7280.c
@@ -2917,7 +2917,7 @@ static struct clk_branch gcc_cfg_noc_lpass_clk = {
 		.enable_mask = BIT(0),
 		.hw.init = &(struct clk_init_data){
 			.name = "gcc_cfg_noc_lpass_clk",
-			.ops = &clk_branch2_ops,
+			.ops = &clk_branch2_aon_ops,
 		},
 	},
 };
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/clk/qcom/gcc-sc7280.c`**
   - The `ops` field of the `gcc_cfg_noc_lpass_clk` structure was changed from `&clk_branch2_ops` to `&clk_branch2_aon_ops`. This modification indicates that the clock operations for the `gcc_cfg_noc_lpass_clk` are now using a different set of operations, specifically those intended for Always-On (AON) clocks.

### Relationships

- The change in the clock operations is made to ensure that the `gcc_cfg_noc_lpass_clk` is always enabled, which is necessary for the proper functioning of the LPASS core and audio drivers. This modification addresses a bug introduced in a previous commit (identified by the hash `a3cc092196ef`), which added the Global Clock Controller (GCC) driver for the SC7280. The patch aims to enhance the reliability of the clock management for the audio subsystem by ensuring that the clock remains enabled at all times.
